Group a catchmentACS run result as a plain tibble

Source: R/run.R
group_by.cacs_run_result.Rd

The cacs_run_result class is only a presentation wrapper around the canonical long-format tibble returned by cacs_run(). dplyr grouping and aggregation therefore drop down to the bare tibble class chain so that classed reconstruction does not interfere with the result.

Usage

group_by.cacs_run_result(.data, ..., .add = FALSE, .drop = NULL)

Arguments

.data

A cacs_run_result, as returned by cacs_run().

...

Grouping variables passed to dplyr::group_by().

.add, .drop

Passed to dplyr::group_by().

Value

A grouped_df without the cacs_run_result presentation class.

See also

cacs_run(), summary.cacs_run_result(), as_tibble.cacs_run_result(), cacs_describe().

Other result summaries: as_tibble.cacs_run_result(), cacs_describe(), cacs_summary_as_markdown(), print.cacs_run_result(), print.cacs_run_summary(), summary.cacs_run_result()
